title: Policies
intro: Relational risk-policy barriers persisted in the control plane and applied to the OpenPit engine per policy. Each row is one barrier for a target.

filter.advancedDescription: Filter by policy kind and numeric barrier values. Account and asset filters stay online in the filter bar.

columnDescriptions.policy: This column shows the risk policy applied by the barrier.
columnDescriptions.scope: This column shows whether the barrier applies globally, to a group, account, asset, or combined target.
columnDescriptions.account: This column shows the account or account group targeted by the barrier when that axis is present.
columnDescriptions.asset: This column shows the asset or account currency targeted by the barrier when that axis is present.
columnDescriptions.values: This column shows the configured numeric or duration values for the policy barrier.
columnDescriptions.actions: This column contains row actions for sharing, editing, and deleting the barrier.

empty.noPoliciesHint: Add the first barrier to start constraining order flow.
empty.noMatchingHint: No barrier matches the current account or policy filter.

restartConfirm.title: Rebuild risk engine?
restartConfirm.description: This policy change rebuilds the risk engine from persisted accounts, limits, rules, and balances. Incoming mutating requests are rejected while the rebuild is in progress.

dialog.rateLimitFootnote: Both max orders and window are required.
dialog.atLeastOneFootnote: At least one value is required.
dialog.fxFailSafeNote: FX fail-safe: an account under PnL control is blocked when a required input is missing, for example an FX quote needed to value realized PnL in the account currency. FX is required only when needed, not for assets already in the account currency and not for accounts outside PnL control.
